title: Tester Acceptance Equals CSP Value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number with $2\le n$, and let $f:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\mathbb F_2$. The acceptance probability of the uniform string tester for the BLR constraints equals the value of the associated constraint satisfaction instance on the assignment $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n with 2 ≤ n
